brief: Prioritise Westmarch Park 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-354) for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure and should be prioritised ahead of younger units in otherwise similar condition (MG-023). Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023).
